description: This file defines a generic data service class `CatalogLookupDataService` for fetching lookup data from an API, using HttpClient and generics, within the BlazorAdmin project namespace.

classes.name: CatalogLookupDataService<TLookupData, TReponse>
classes.description: A generic service class that provides methods to retrieve lookup data of type TLookupData from a web API, using HttpClient.

methods.name: CatalogLookupDataService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpClient, Logger, and API URL from configuration.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of lookup data items from the API endpoint defined by the TLookupData's EndpointAttribute.
